interview.name: Gus
interview.answer: The repair drive is at the community shed on Saturday morning.

reflections: Gus is taking a coordinating role and responding quickly to logistics questions.
Pia is interested and willing to help, but needs clear timing and access details before committing fully.

Gus is the central coordinator and keeps reinforcing the time, place, and drop-off instructions so everyone stays aligned.
Jules acts as a helper for spreading information, while Sam contributes concrete tools and labor to support the event.
Rosa’s message suggests the plan may have shifted from Saturday at the shed to Sunday at the community center, and Gus is accommodating that change.
Gus is coordinating the repair drive and repeatedly confirms the community shed on Saturday morning as the main meetup point.
Rosa and Bo are aligning with Gus by helping anchor the event at a shared location and bringing supplies or notifying people.
Ira is less committed to a fixed plan but remains willing to help later after errands, suggesting flexible support rather than direct coordination.
Gus is the organizer and coordinator; he keeps confirming the plan and offering tools, space, and organization support.
The group is aligned around a shared Saturday morning repair drive at the community shed, with people contributing small needed supplies.
Participants seem to be checking details rather than renegotiating the plan, suggesting the event is mostly settled and just needs execution.
